title: Is There an A.I. Bubble? And What if It Pops?

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson, and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森，欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其背后文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you, and you turned a DJ booth
sentences.zh: 即便是在黑胶唱片时代的夜店当DJ时，你每晚都要带着300件最珍贵的收藏去工作，然后把DJ台

sentences.en: into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 变成一个充满活力的、临时性的博物馆，展示着那些精美的、有50年历史的艺术品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你最喜欢的播客平台上收听爱彼（Audemars Piguet）出品的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Natalie Kittroweff.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的娜塔莉·基特罗夫。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: After years of soaring optimism and massive investment in the AI boom, in recent weeks,
sentences.zh: 在经历了多年高涨的乐观情绪和对人工智能热潮的大规模投资后，最近几周，

sentences.en: Wall Street has begun to seriously question whether that optimism was overblown and whether we're actually in a bubble that may soon pop.
sentences.zh: 华尔街开始认真质疑这种乐观情绪是否被夸大了，以及我们是否正处于一个可能很快就会破裂的泡沫之中。

sentences.en: And yet, despite all that hand-wringing,
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管有种种担忧，

sentences.en: Silicon Valley has only doubled down, projecting total confidence about the hundreds of billions of dollars it's pouring into the technology.
sentences.zh: 硅谷却反而加倍下注，对投入该技术的数千亿美元表现出十足的信心。

sentences.en: Today, my colleague Cade Metz explains why.
sentences.zh: 今天，我的同事凯德·梅茨将解释原因。

sentences.en: Why tech companies believe so fervently in AI.
sentences.zh: 为什么科技公司如此狂热地相信人工智能。

sentences.en: Why they're willing to take huge risks to deliver on its promise.
sentences.zh: 为什么他们愿意冒巨大的风险去实现它的承诺。

sentences.en: And whether that bet could backfire.
sentences.zh: 以及这场赌注是否会适得其反。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, November 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是11月20日，星期四。

sentences.en: Cade, it seems like the conversation on Wall Street, among investors, in Silicon Valley, even in Washington these days, has gone from whether we're in an AI bubble
sentences.zh: 凯德，现在华尔街、投资者、硅谷，甚至华盛顿的谈话似乎都已经从“我们是否处于人工智能泡沫中”

sentences.en: to the general sense that, yes, we probably are in some sort of a bubble.
sentences.zh: 转向了一种普遍的共识：是的，我们可能确实处于某种泡沫之中。

sentences.en: And yet, the companies that you cover from your perch in Silicon Valley, they're continuing to spend huge amounts of cash on this.
sentences.zh: 然而，你在硅谷报道的那些公司，依然在为此投入巨额资金。

sentences.en: So, explain to us, what is their justification for spending all this money?
sentences.zh: 那么，请向我们解释一下，他们投入所有这些资金的理由是什么？

sentences.en: Well, three years after the arrival of ChatGPT,
sentences.zh: 嗯，在ChatGPT问世三年后，

sentences.en: the open AI chatbot that really started this AI boom, this is clearly a powerful and, in some ways, transformative technology.
sentences.zh: 这个真正开启了人工智能热潮的开放式人工智能聊天机器人，显然是一项强大且在某些方面具有变革性的技术。

sentences.en: It's used not only to search the internet in new ways, it can help people do specific tasks in a faster and more efficient way than they did in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 它不仅被用于以新的方式搜索互联网，还能帮助人们以比过去更快、更高效的方式完成特定任务。

sentences.en: You see businesses adopting services that can transcribe meetings.
sentences.zh: 你可以看到企业正在采用能够转录会议的服务。

sentences.en: You see other applications in healthcare.
sentences.zh: 你也可以在医疗保健领域看到其他应用。

sentences.en: There are ways that this technology is already changing the way we live and the way we work.
sentences.zh: 这项技术已经在改变我们的生活和工作方式。

sentences.en: And these companies, and this is classic Silicon Valley, see much bigger transformations on the horizon.
sentences.zh: 而这些公司——这是典型的硅谷作风——预见到未来会有更大的变革。

sentences.en: These are people, executives, these titans of industry are looking not just at what is possible today, but what they think this technology will do in the future.
sentences.zh: 这些人，这些高管，这些行业巨头，不仅着眼于今天能做什么，更着眼于他们认为这项技术在未来能做什么。

sentences.en: And the idea is that that future, it's going to be really expensive to build.
sentences.zh: 而他们的想法是，那个未来，构建起来将会非常昂贵。

sentences.en: Well, fundamentally, this technology is expensive to build.
sentences.zh: 从根本上说，这项技术构建起来确实很昂贵。

sentences.en: It's a mind-boggling amount of money, even for people who have spent decades in the tech industry.
sentences.zh: 即使对于在科技行业工作了几十年的人来说，这笔钱也是一个令人难以置信的数字。

sentences.en: OpenAI alone has said it's going to spend $500 billion on data centers in the United States alone to drive these technologies.
sentences.zh: 仅OpenAI一家就表示，它将在美国投入5000亿美元建设数据中心，以推动这些技术的发展。

sentences.en: Let's stop for a second and think about what that means.
sentences.zh: 让我们停下来想一想这意味着什么。

sentences.en: $500 billion in today's money could fund about 15 Manhattan projects.
sentences.zh: 以今天的货币价值计算，5000亿美元足以资助大约15个曼哈顿计划。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: It could fund the Apollo program two times over.
sentences.zh: 它足以资助阿波罗计划两次以上。

sentences.en: The program that sent humans to space, yeah.
sentences.zh: 那个将人类送入太空的项目，没错。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: And that's just the money to drive AI for a single startup, OpenAI.
sentences.zh: 而这仅仅是一家初创公司OpenAI推动人工智能所需的资金。

sentences.en: All told, if you look at what is being spent across the globe, not just the U.S., we're talking about nearly $3 trillion.
sentences.zh: 总而言之，如果你看看全球范围内的支出，不仅仅是美国，我们谈论的是近3万亿美元。

sentences.en: That's an awful lot of money for a technology that is transformative, but is in many ways still speculative, meaning what they see in the future is so big.
sentences.zh: 对于一项具有变革性但又在许多方面仍处于投机阶段的技术来说，这确实是一笔巨款，这意味着他们所预见的未来极其宏大。

sentences.en: They, in many cases, believe they're building what is called, in the Valley, artificial general intelligence, a machine that can do anything the human brain can do.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，他们相信自己正在构建硅谷所说的“通用人工智能”，即一种能够完成人类大脑所能做任何事情的机器。

sentences.en: Can we just pause?
sentences.zh: 我们可以暂停一下吗？

sentences.en: I want you to just define this term for me, artificial general intelligence.
sentences.zh: 我想让你为我定义一下“通用人工智能”这个术语。

sentences.en: We hear it a lot.
sentences.zh: 我们经常听到这个词。

sentences.en: We've talked about it on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们在节目中也讨论过它。

sentences.en: It seems kind of hard to get your head around.
sentences.zh: 这似乎很难理解。

sentences.en: Like, what does it mean, actually, Cade?
sentences.zh: 凯德，它到底是什么意思？

sentences.en: It's shorthand for a machine that can do all of the economically valuable work that people like you and I do on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 它是指一种能够完成你我每天所做的所有具有经济价值工作的机器的简称。

sentences.en: They want to essentially replace all human workers.
sentences.zh: 他们本质上是想取代所有人类劳动者。

sentences.en: They want to give the world a technology that can do any job.
sentences.zh: 他们想给世界提供一种能胜任任何工作的技术。

sentences.en: That, in theory, is worth all this spending.
sentences.zh: 从理论上讲，这值得所有的投入。

sentences.en: But it's worth saying that we don't know how to get to such a goal.
sentences.zh: 但必须指出的是，我们还不知道如何实现这一目标。

sentences.en: That is a lofty thing to reach for.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极其宏伟的目标。

sentences.en: But so many Silicon Valley executives remain undeterred.
sentences.zh: 但许多硅谷高管仍然毫不动摇。

sentences.en: Mark Zuckerberg, CEO of Meta.
sentences.zh: Meta首席执行官马克·扎克伯格。

sentences.en: I would guess that, like, sometime in the next 12 to 18 months, we'll reach the point where, like, most of the code that's going towards these efforts is written by AI.
sentences.zh: 我猜，在未来12到18个月内的某个时候，我们将达到这样一个点：大部分用于这些工作的代码都将由人工智能编写。

sentences.en: Jensen Wang, the CEO of NVIDIA.
sentences.zh: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋。

sentences.en: If there's one thing that I would encourage everybody to do is to go get yourself an AI tutor right away.
sentences.zh: 如果有一件事我鼓励大家去做，那就是立刻给自己找一个人工智能导师。

sentences.en: We're going to become super humans because we have super AIs.
sentences.zh: 我们将成为超级人类，因为我们拥有超级人工智能。

sentences.en: They are all making the case that this spending makes sense.
sentences.zh: 他们都在论证这种支出是合理的。

sentences.en: The poster child of this attitude is Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI.
sentences.zh: 这种态度的典型代表是OpenAI的首席执行官萨姆·奥特曼。

sentences.en: There are not many times that I want to be a public company, but one of the rare times it's appealing is when those people that are writing these ridiculous OpenAI
sentences.zh: 我不想成为上市公司的次数并不多，但其中一个罕见的吸引力在于，当那些撰写这些荒谬的OpenAI

sentences.en: is about to go out of business and, you know, whatever.
sentences.zh: 即将倒闭之类的文章的人，你知道的，随便什么内容。

sentences.en: I would love to tell them they could just short the stock, and I would love to see them get burned on that.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意告诉他们，他们可以直接做空股票，我很想看到他们因此而亏得血本无归。

sentences.en: He has told the rest of the world to bet against his company at their own risk, and he continues to flaunt the company's spending.
sentences.zh: 他告诉全世界，做空他的公司后果自负，并且他继续炫耀公司的支出。

sentences.en: He and the rest of the industry are all in.
sentences.zh: 他和整个行业都全力以赴了。

sentences.en: But what they promised hasn't been delivered on the timeline that they promised.
sentences.zh: 但他们承诺的事情并没有按照他们承诺的时间表实现。

sentences.en: So, again, just explain why they're still going even harder at this thing if it isn't panning out yet.
sentences.zh: 所以，再次请解释一下，如果这件事还没有成功，为什么他们还在加大投入？

sentences.en: Obviously, they aren't trying to throw money in the trash, right?
sentences.zh: 显然，他们不是想把钱扔进垃圾桶，对吧？

sentences.en: Do you know about the concept of FOMO, fear of missing out?
sentences.zh: 你知道“错失恐惧症”（FOMO）这个概念吗？

sentences.en: That's a lot of what is driving this.
sentences.zh: 这在很大程度上推动了这一切。

sentences.en: Do I ever.
sentences.zh: 我当然知道。

sentences.en: No one wants to miss out on what could be the most transformative technology the world has ever seen.
sentences.zh: 没有人想错过这可能是世界上有史以来最具变革性的技术。

sentences.en: And if you don't want to miss out on that, you have to make your bet now.
sentences.zh: 如果你不想错过，你就必须现在下注。

sentences.en: These data centers, not only are they expensive, they take a long time to build.
sentences.zh: 这些数据中心不仅昂贵，而且建设周期很长。

sentences.en: And so, almost by definition, you have to make a bet.
sentences.zh: 所以，几乎可以肯定，你必须进行一场赌博。

sentences.en: On something that's years down the road.
sentences.zh: 赌的是几年后的未来。

sentences.en: But there may be a disconnect between the money that's being spent now and what is possible just a few years down the road.
sentences.zh: 但现在投入的资金与几年后可能实现的目标之间，可能存在脱节。

sentences.en: What you're saying is that the upside for these companies of taking this massive gamble on what is essentially,
sentences.zh: 你的意思是，这些公司在本质上进行这场豪赌的潜在收益，

sentences.en: as you've described it, a moonshot of reaching artificial general intelligence is that you might be the company that lands on the moon.
sentences.zh: 正如你所描述的，是一场实现通用人工智能的“登月计划”，而你可能就是那个成功登月的公司。

sentences.en: The downside, though, is what if these companies are wrong?
sentences.zh: 然而，不利的一面是，如果这些公司错了怎么办？

sentences.en: What if there is no moon landing?
sentences.zh: 如果根本没有登月成功呢？

sentences.en: What if there's no moon landing?
sentences.zh: 如果根本没有登月成功呢？

sentences.en: Or what if only one company lands on the moon?
sentences.zh: 或者如果只有一家公司登月成功了呢？

sentences.en: Or what if only two land there and the rest are left hanging?
sentences.zh: 或者如果只有两家成功了，而其余的都被晾在一边呢？

sentences.en: This is a situation where even if somebody wins, a lot of people are going to lose.
sentences.zh: 这是一种即使有人赢了，也会有很多人输的情况。

sentences.en: Sam Altman, the chief executive of OpenAI, said as much during a dinner I attended here in San Francisco this summer.
sentences.zh: OpenAI首席执行官萨姆·奥特曼今年夏天在旧金山参加的一次晚宴上就曾这样说过。

sentences.en: He said, rhetorically, are we in a phase where investors as a whole are overexcited about AI?
sentences.zh: 他反问道，我们是否正处于一个投资者整体对人工智能过度兴奋的阶段？

sentences.en: In my opinion, he said, yes.
sentences.zh: 他认为，是的。

sentences.en: He acknowledged that a lot of this spending was, at least in some ways, irrational.
sentences.zh: 他承认，很多支出在某种程度上至少是不理性的。

sentences.en: And he said that there would be losers in this scenario.
sentences.zh: 他还表示，在这种情况下会有输家。

sentences.en: After this dinner, which made headlines across the country and across the world, a lot of people started using the word bubble.
sentences.zh: 在那次晚宴之后，这成为了全国乃至全世界的头条新闻，很多人开始使用“泡沫”这个词。

sentences.en: And when I talk to people here in Silicon Valley and financial analysts and tech historians about this moment we're living through,
sentences.zh: 当我与硅谷的人、金融分析师和科技历史学家谈论我们所处的这个时刻时，

sentences.en: what they often point back to is the dot-com bubble of the late 90s and 2000s, when early internet technologies showed enormous promise
sentences.zh: 他们经常提到90年代末和2000年代的互联网泡沫，当时早期的互联网技术展现出了巨大的前景，

sentences.en: and the Valley started to invest enormous amounts of money in it.
sentences.zh: 而硅谷开始向其中投入巨额资金。

sentences.en: Okay, let's talk about the dot-com bubble and specifically what's different and what's similar to the moment that we're in now with AI.
sentences.zh: 好的，让我们谈谈互联网泡沫，具体来说，它与我们现在所处的人工智能时代有什么不同和相似之处。

sentences.en: Well, for people who live through the bubble, what they often think of is an enormous number of startups that were created and that went public and had huge valuations,
sentences.zh: 嗯，对于经历过那个泡沫的人来说，他们经常想到的是大量初创公司被创建、上市并拥有极高的估值，

sentences.en: even though they had little or no business model, certainly no revenues, and then when the market crashed,
sentences.zh: 尽管它们几乎没有商业模式，当然也没有收入，然后当市场崩盘时，

sentences.en: when people decided that the spending was getting ahead of what was possible, a lot of those companies went out of business.
sentences.zh: 当人们认为支出已经超出了可能实现的范围时，许多公司就倒闭了。

sentences.en: Companies like Cosmo that delivered goods straight to your door,
sentences.zh: 像Cosmo这样直接送货上门的公司，

sentences.en: Pets.com, which sent you pet food.
sentences.zh: 还有寄送宠物食品的Pets.com。

sentences.en: There are famous examples of this, and that's often what people think of.
sentences.zh: 这些都是著名的例子，人们通常会想到这些。

sentences.en: But underneath that, and this is where the analogy really holds up to today.
sentences.zh: 但在那之下——这正是类比在今天真正成立的地方。

sentences.en: As those startups were being built, there were other companies that were building the infrastructure needed to drive the internet,
sentences.zh: 当那些初创公司正在建立时，还有其他公司在建设驱动互联网所需的基础设施，

sentences.en: that were spending enormous amounts of money to lay the fiber optic cable that would carry all that information across the internet to our machines.
sentences.zh: 它们投入了巨额资金铺设光缆，将所有信息通过互联网传输到我们的机器上。

sentences.en: When the bubble burst, a lot of those companies went bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 当泡沫破裂时，许多这样的公司破产了。

sentences.en: And that's often what people are thinking about as they look back at the dot-com bubble.
sentences.zh: 这就是人们回顾互联网泡沫时经常想到的。

sentences.en: Meaning there's a fear that the companies that are laying the fiber optics of the AI revolution, which is, you know,
sentences.zh: 意思是人们担心那些正在为人工智能革命铺设光缆的公司——你知道的，

sentences.en: the analogy would say these data centers that are housing all of these chips, that those companies could go under.
sentences.zh: 类比来说就是那些容纳所有芯片的数据中心——这些公司可能会倒闭。

sentences.en: That's the fear.
sentences.zh: 这就是恐惧所在。

sentences.en: Just like then, you have companies spending enormous amounts of money on the infrastructure needed to drive on this.
sentences.zh: 就像那时一样，现在的公司也在为推动这一切所需的基础设施投入巨额资金。

sentences.en: The difference is they are spending a lot more today than they did 25 years ago.
sentences.zh: 不同之处在于，他们今天花的钱比25年前多得多。

sentences.en: But I'm struck by the fact, Cade, that obviously the dot-com bubble, it burst, but there were many, many winners, right?
sentences.zh: 但我感到震惊的是，凯德，显然互联网泡沫破裂了，但还是有很多很多赢家，对吧？

sentences.en: I mean, we still have, as you said, a lot of these companies that were born in that era.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，正如你所说，我们仍然拥有许多那个时代诞生的公司。

sentences.en: So what's the takeaway there?
sentences.zh: 那么结论是什么呢？

sentences.en: This is a great point.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的观点。

sentences.en: So many of the applications that were promised by all those startups that went out of business are part of our daily lives today.
sentences.zh: 那些倒闭的初创公司所承诺的许多应用，如今已成为我们日常生活的一部分。

sentences.en: Amazon delivers our pet food.
sentences.zh: 亚马逊为我们运送宠物食品。

sentences.en: Other companies deliver our real-time internet video.
sentences.zh: 其他公司为我们提供实时互联网视频。

sentences.en: So many of the things that were promised in, we have today.
sentences.zh: 当时承诺的许多事情，我们今天都拥有了。

sentences.en: And we're actually using that fiber optic cable that was laid and that sat there dormant for many years.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上正在使用那些铺设后闲置了多年的光缆。

sentences.en: And we are now reaping the benefits.
sentences.zh: 我们现在正在享受这些好处。

sentences.en: It's just that it didn't happen as quickly as a lot of people thought.
sentences.zh: 只是它发生的速度没有很多人想象的那么快。

sentences.en: So for Silicon Valley, it sounds like the lesson of that bubble could very easily be,
sentences.zh: 所以对于硅谷来说，那个泡沫的教训似乎很容易就是：

sentences.en: Sure, some people lose in a situation like that.
sentences.zh: 当然，在那种情况下有些人会输。

sentences.en: But broadly, the bet on the internet was worth it.
sentences.zh: 但从大局来看，对互联网的押注是值得的。

sentences.en: It paid off.
sentences.zh: 它得到了回报。

sentences.en: So take the bet.
sentences.zh: 所以，下注吧。

sentences.en: So many people I talk to say that very thing.
sentences.zh: 我交谈过的许多人都说了同样的话。

sentences.en: Okay, Cade, let's get into the scary thing that you brought up before the break, that the risks here could be much more significant.
sentences.zh: 好的，凯德，我们来聊聊你在休息前提到的那个可怕的事情，即这里的风险可能要严重得多。

sentences.en: Talk to me about that.
sentences.zh: 跟我说说看。

sentences.en: Well, as I discuss this with all sorts of people,
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如我和各种各样的人讨论的那样，

sentences.en: including technologists but also financial analysts, the other thing that often comes up is the housing bubble of the late 2000s, which was a much more serious thing.
sentences.zh: 包括技术专家，也包括金融分析师，另一个经常被提及的话题是21世纪末的房地产泡沫，那是一件严重得多的事情。

sentences.en: People generally agree that this is not what we're going through at the moment.
sentences.zh: 人们普遍认为，我们目前所经历的并不是那种情况。

sentences.en: Let's not go that far.
sentences.zh: 我们还没到那一步。

sentences.en: That said, they do point out that there are elements that we're seeing now that were also present then.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，他们确实指出，我们现在看到的一些因素在当时也存在。

sentences.en: What are those elements?
sentences.zh: 是哪些因素呢？

sentences.en: What's worrying them?
sentences.zh: 什么让他们感到担忧？

sentences.en: Basically, this is about the enormous amount of debt that is being taken on to build these data centers, the enormous amount of money that's being borrowed to build them.
sentences.zh: 基本上，这是关于为了建造这些数据中心而背负的巨额债务，也就是为了建造它们而借入的巨额资金。

sentences.en: And as you look at that debt, it's hard to know how much there is and who is holding the debt.
sentences.zh: 当你审视这些债务时，很难知道到底有多少，以及谁持有这些债务。

sentences.en: If that debt is spread across a lot of companies, then you have more systemic risk.
sentences.zh: 如果这些债务分散在许多公司身上，那么你就会面临更大的系统性风险。

sentences.en: You have greater risk that could damage the rest of the economy.
sentences.zh: 你面临的更大风险可能会损害经济的其他部分。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That was the thing that made the 2008 crash so bad, the amount of debt that had piled up under the housing market.
sentences.zh: 这就是导致2008年崩盘的原因，房地产市场下堆积了大量的债务。

sentences.en: But these tech companies, they're some of the richest corporations in the world.
sentences.zh: 但这些科技公司，它们是世界上最富有的公司之一。

sentences.en: So why are they financing the AI boom with debt?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么它们要靠举债来资助人工智能热潮呢？

sentences.en: Why is that happening?
sentences.zh: 为什么会这样？

sentences.en: Well, some companies are not taking on debt to do this.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有些公司并不是通过举债来做这件事的。

sentences.en: Some companies like Google and Microsoft and Meta pull in billions of dollars in revenue every year.
sentences.zh: 像谷歌、微软和Meta这样的一些公司每年都有数十亿美元的收入。

sentences.en: They can afford to essentially pay cash for these giant data centers.
sentences.zh: 它们基本上有能力用现金支付这些巨大的数据中心。

sentences.en: But there's so much interest in AI.
sentences.zh: 但人们对人工智能的兴趣太浓厚了。

sentences.en: There's so much demand for the computing power that comes out of these data centers that we're seeing all sorts of other companies build these giant facilities
sentences.zh: 对这些数据中心产生的计算能力需求巨大，以至于我们看到各种各样的其他公司都在建造这些巨大的设施，

sentences.en: when they don't have the money to do it.
sentences.zh: 而它们并没有足够的资金来做这件事。

sentences.en: Even relatively big companies like Oracle, the cloud computing giant, is having to take on debt to build data centers.
sentences.zh: 即使是像甲骨文（Oracle）这样相对较大的云计算巨头，也不得不举债来建造数据中心。

sentences.en: And then you have all these smaller companies that most people on Earth have never heard of with names like CoreWeave, Lambda, and Nebius.
sentences.zh: 然后还有所有这些地球上大多数人从未听说过的小公司，名字像CoreWeave、Lambda和Nebius。

sentences.en: Definitely never heard of them.
sentences.zh: 确实从来没听说过它们。

sentences.en: They are certainly taking on debt to do this.
sentences.zh: 它们肯定是在举债做这件事。

sentences.en: CoreWeave, a company based in the New York, New Jersey area, has told financial analysts that for every $5 billion in data center infrastructure they build,
sentences.zh: 总部位于纽约、新泽西地区的一家公司CoreWeave告诉金融分析师，他们每建造50亿美元的数据中心基础设施，

sentences.en: they have to take on almost $3 billion in debt.
sentences.zh: 就必须背负近30亿美元的债务。

sentences.en: In the end, they think that they will pull in the revenues needed to pay back those debts.
sentences.zh: 最终，他们认为自己会获得偿还这些债务所需的收入。

sentences.en: But ultimately, if the AI technology does not pull in the money, then you can't repay those debts.
sentences.zh: 但归根结底，如果人工智能技术不能带来收益，那么你就无法偿还这些债务。

sentences.en: And that's when you have a problem.
sentences.zh: 那就是你遇到麻烦的时候了。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: And I was struck by something else that you said, Cade, which is that when you look at the debt here, it's actually hard to know how much of it there is.
sentences.zh: 凯德，你说的另一件事让我印象深刻，那就是当你审视这里的债务时，实际上很难知道它到底有多少。

sentences.en: What's that about?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Why don't we know that?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们不知道？

sentences.en: Well, some of the debt is taken on in the way you might think.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有些债务是以你可能想到的方式承担的。

sentences.en: Like, these companies go to a bank and they borrow the money and you know exactly who lent it, who borrowed it, how much it is.
sentences.zh: 比如，这些公司去银行借钱，你知道是谁借的，谁贷的，金额是多少。

sentences.en: But increasingly, we're seeing other deals where it's hard to see where the debt is and how much of it there is.
sentences.zh: 但我们越来越多地看到其他交易，很难看出债务在哪里，有多少。

sentences.en: A lot of the money is being lent by what are called private credit institutions.
sentences.zh: 很多钱是由所谓的私人信贷机构借出的。

sentences.en: Legally, you can't see inside these companies.
sentences.zh: 从法律上讲，你无法看透这些公司内部。

sentences.en: The other thing that's happening is you're seeing the rise of these securities.
sentences.zh: 另一件正在发生的事情是，你看到了这些证券的兴起。

sentences.en: They call them asset-backed securities.
sentences.zh: 他们称之为资产支持证券。

sentences.en: Something that came up during the housing bubble that people may be familiar with.
sentences.zh: 房地产泡沫期间出现过类似的东西，人们可能很熟悉。

sentences.en: Reminiscent in a not great way.
sentences.zh: 以一种不太好的方式让人想起过去。

sentences.en: These securities can be bought and sold and traded.
sentences.zh: 这些证券可以被买卖和交易。

sentences.en: And that means you don't know, in the end, who is holding the debt.
sentences.zh: 这意味着你最终不知道是谁持有这些债务。

sentences.en: You're saying there's this idea, right, that there could be real systemic risk baked into all this debt.
sentences.zh: 你是说有一种观点，对吧，认为所有这些债务中可能隐藏着真正的系统性风险。

sentences.en: That the leverage in the system is just hard to pin down.
sentences.zh: 系统中的杠杆作用很难确定。

sentences.en: And so we really can't actually know at this point how exposed we all might be to it.
sentences.zh: 所以我们现在真的无法知道我们所有人对此的风险敞口有多大。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: There could be a problem.
sentences.zh: 可能会有问题。

sentences.en: It's hard to know.
sentences.zh: 很难说。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It's obviously a really murky thing.
sentences.zh: 这显然是一件非常模糊的事情。

sentences.en: But is there anything that we know definitively about the magnitude of the debt in the system?
sentences.zh: 但是，关于系统中债务的规模，我们有什么明确的了解吗？

sentences.en: About how big we're talking?
sentences.zh: 我们谈论的规模有多大？

sentences.en: As I said earlier, it's projected that companies across the world will spend nearly $3 trillion on these data centers.
sentences.zh: 正如我之前所说，预计全球各地的公司将在这些数据中心上花费近3万亿美元。

sentences.en: Analysts at Morgan Stanley project that about a third of that will be debt, $1 trillion.
sentences.zh: 摩根士丹利的分析师预计，其中约三分之一将是债务，即1万亿美元。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Just pulling back from what you're saying, it sounds like it's actually quite hard to know what kind of bubble we may be in right now and how bad or not bad it may be.
sentences.zh: 退一步说，听起来确实很难知道我们现在处于什么样的泡沫中，以及它可能有多糟糕或不那么糟糕。

sentences.en: I mean, there's the dot-com example, right, which had fallout, but it sounds like was relatively contained and produced all these winners.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，有互联网泡沫的例子，对吧，它产生了后果，但听起来相对可控，并且造就了所有这些赢家。

sentences.en: And then there's the much riskier version of things, closer to elements of things that we saw during the housing crisis that could have a much broader effect.
sentences.zh: 然后是风险大得多的版本，更接近我们在住房危机期间看到的一些因素，可能会产生更广泛的影响。

sentences.en: And because of all that's unknowable in all this, we can't really tell.
sentences.zh: 而且由于这一切中存在太多不可知因素，我们真的无法判断。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: We can't.
sentences.zh: 我们无法判断。

sentences.en: If things do burst, it's hard to even know when that might happen.
sentences.zh: 如果泡沫真的破裂，甚至很难知道它何时会发生。

sentences.en: And people like Sam Altman and Sundar Pichai, the CEO of Alphabet, the Google parent company, have acknowledged this uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 像萨姆·奥特曼（Sam Altman）和谷歌母公司Alphabet的首席执行官桑达尔·皮查伊（Sundar Pichai）这样的人已经承认了这种不确定性。

sentences.en: You know, there's this irony that I've been thinking about in all this, which is that in
sentences.zh: 你知道，我一直在思考这一切中的讽刺之处，那就是在

sentences.en: some ways, the worst case scenario for the companies that are invested in the AI boom, right, is that
sentences.zh: 某种程度上，对于投资人工智能热潮的公司来说，最坏的情况是，对吧，那就是

sentences.en: they never actually reach AGI, that point where computers replace human workers en masse, where
sentences.zh: 它们永远无法真正实现通用人工智能（AGI），即计算机大规模取代人类工人的那一点，即

sentences.en: AI becomes as smart as the human brain, or that that really takes a very long time.
sentences.zh: 人工智能变得和人脑一样聪明，或者这真的需要很长时间。

sentences.en: But I think there's a lot of us human workers who might actually view that worst case scenario for Silicon Valley as a relief.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们很多劳动者可能实际上会将硅谷的这种最坏情况视为一种解脱。

sentences.en: Like, people might be happy, generally, to hear that we aren't going to be replaced en masse tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 就像，人们可能普遍会很高兴听到我们明天不会被大规模取代。

sentences.en: And I wonder what you make of that tension, the fact that the future that they're building toward here may not actually be a future that all that many people actually want.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你如何看待这种张力，即他们正在构建的未来可能实际上并不是很多人真正想要的未来。

sentences.en: It's a great point.
sentences.zh: 这是一个很好的观点。

sentences.en: As we think about this moment, we need to realize the realities of this technology.
sentences.zh: 当我们思考这一时刻时，我们需要意识到这项技术的现实。

sentences.en: It is very powerful in many ways.
sentences.zh: 它在许多方面都非常强大。

sentences.en: Health care being perhaps the prime example.
sentences.zh: 医疗保健也许是最好的例子。

sentences.en: Drug discovery.
sentences.zh: 药物发现。

sentences.en: We are on the path towards some amazing things.
sentences.zh: 我们正走在通往一些惊人成就的道路上。

sentences.en: At the same time, we're on the path towards some things that are concerning.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，我们也正走在通往一些令人担忧的事情的道路上。

sentences.en: If things don't progress at the pace that Silicon Valley says, this could cause problems across the larger economy, as we talked about.
sentences.zh: 如果事情没有按照硅谷所说的速度发展，这可能会像我们讨论的那样，在更大的经济范围内引发问题。

sentences.en: But it might give us the time we need to continue to think about all the big questions that hang over this technology and that hang over our future.
sentences.zh: 但这可能会给我们时间，让我们继续思考悬在这项技术之上以及悬在我们未来之上的所有重大问题。

sentences.en: It might give us time to prepare for that future.
sentences.zh: 它可能会给我们时间为那个未来做好准备。
